OrbisNet is a decentralized social and messaging platform powered by Nostr relays with zero central servers, protected by end-to-end encryption.
How does OrbisNet work with Nostr relays?
Decentralized communication via open Nostr relay network.

OrbisNet does not use any centralized servers. Every text message, voice note, and social post is encrypted directly on your device and transmitted over decentralized Nostr relays. Your data never passes through a central server — only through open, distributed relay nodes that cannot read your encrypted payloads.
How do I start my first encrypted chat?
Automatic public key exchange or face-to-face QR Code scan.

When you first message a contact, OrbisNet automatically sends a secure public key exchange request via Nostr. Once accepted, your chats are end-to-end encrypted. You can also scan their QR Code in person from the Contacts tab to verify their identity instantly.
How do encrypted voice notes work?
Ultra-compressed voice notes with interactive waveform player.

Hold the microphone button to record your voice note. OrbisNet compresses the audio using high-efficiency codecs and encrypts it with AES-256. Upon arrival via Nostr relays, the payload is decrypted and can be played with waveform scrubbing and speed controls (1x, 1.5x, 2x).
Automatic message expiration from 10 seconds to 7 days.

Inside any conversation, tap the options menu (⋮) and select \'Ephemeral Messages\'. Choose your timer (10s, 1m, 1h, 24h, 7d). As soon as the recipient reads your message, the countdown begins and the message is permanently wiped from both devices.
How do Encrypted Voice Calls (E2EE) work?
Nostr relay signaling, direct P2P audio stream encrypted with AES-256-GCM and zero cloud servers.

OrbisNet initiates secure voice calls by sending an encrypted Nostr event (Call Offer). When your contact accepts, an answer event establishes a direct, encrypted audio stream over AES-256-GCM. No cloud servers, no web intermediaries, and complete immunity against eavesdropping.
Instant relay failure detection, caller notification, and GSM voice fallback.

If Nostr relay connectivity fails, OrbisNet detects the issue in real time and offers to switch to a standard GSM voice call as fallback. The caller is notified immediately so the conversation can continue seamlessly.
What is the SAS Security Safety Code during a call?
Visual/verbal short authentication string derived from Schnorr fingerprints to verify zero wiretaps.

The Short Authentication String (SAS) is a cryptographic code displayed at the top of the call screen. By reading it aloud to your contact, both participants mathematically certify that no Man-in-the-Middle is intercepting the call.
How does guaranteed secure hangup work?
Dedicated-thread termination burst, Nostr end event and 4.5-second Dead-Peer watchdog.

When you hang up, OrbisNet emits a rapid burst of termination frames on a dedicated thread, dispatches a Call End event via Nostr, and activates a Dead-Peer watchdog timer. If connectivity drops, both devices automatically terminate the call session within 4.5 seconds to protect battery and privacy.
How do social feed and 24h stories work?
Serverless decentralized social network exclusively between confirmed friends.

The social timeline and 24h stories operate entirely on decentralized Nostr relays strictly between confirmed friends and trusted circles. Posts, polls and statuses are shared only with your accepted friends without any central server holding your data.
How do I manage two SIM cards?
Switch active line in 1 tap from the top header avatar.

OrbisNet automatically detects both inserted SIM cards. Tap your avatar in the top-right header (displaying \'SIM 1\' or \'SIM 2\') to switch your active line instantly or create a second isolated profile with its own encryption keys and message history.
How to manage contacts and create groups?
Full phone address book, encrypted groups and QR verification.

In the Contacts tab, browse your entire phone directory. Tap \'New Group\' to start an encrypted group conversation with shared AES encryption, or \'New Contact\' to add by npub address or phone number.
How to secure the app with a PIN code?
Biometric unlock, PIN code, and encrypted local storage.

In Settings > Security, enable PIN code lock or fingerprint authentication. All local data is encrypted at rest, and you can export an offline encrypted backup vault (.orbis) to safeguard your conversations.
Real-time message tracking and relay optimization.
In Settings > Relay Usage & Statistics, view your real-time daily and monthly sent message stats. OrbisNet automatically optimizes event payloads for efficient relay transmission.
GPS Sharing: share satellite coordinates via encrypted Nostr relay events.

How to create and vote in Polls?
Sovereign polls distributed via Nostr with real-time percentage graphs.

In the Social Feed, create a decentralized poll with multiple options. When friends in your circle vote, their choices are returned as signed Nostr events. OrbisNet automatically tallies votes in real time, displays percentage bars, and ensures each voter can only vote once per poll.
Ephemeral 24h statuses with text, gradients, and avatar indicator rings.

Share ephemeral status updates that last 24 hours. Stories can include custom text or photos with elegant gradient backdrops. Friends with active stories display an active glowing ring around their avatar in the feed and chat list. Stories self-destruct automatically after 24 hours.
How to use Emoji Reactions and Comments?
One-tap emoji reactions (❤️, 🔥, 👏, 💡, 🛡️) in chats, posts, and nested comments.

Express yourself instantly without sending extra messages. Tap or long-press any chat bubble, feed post, or story to attach emoji reactions. In the social timeline, you can also engage in threaded discussions by commenting directly under posts.
How does GPS Geolocation sharing work?
Direct satellite location capture transmitted via encrypted Nostr relay.

Inside any conversation, open the attachment menu (+) and choose \'Share GPS Location\'. OrbisNet queries the hardware satellite GPS receiver directly. Once locked, your precise latitude and longitude are transmitted via encrypted Nostr event and can be opened in Google Maps or OpenStreetMap.
How do Sovereign Groups and Circles work?
Shared AES-256 group keys, contact circles (Family, Friends, Work) and Nostr relay broadcast.

Create encrypted group chats linked to Sovereign Circles (Family, Friends, Work, Community). Each group generates a unique AES-256 key. When you send a message in a group, OrbisNet automatically encrypts and broadcasts it via Nostr relays to all members simultaneously.
What is the Developer Console and System Telemetry?
Real-time cryptographic sandbox, system health diagnostics and Nostr relay logs.

Accessible in Settings > Developer Console, this sovereign diagnostics center lets you run live validation benchmarks on AES-256-GCM and BIP-340 Schnorr routines, inspect memory/battery footprint, and review Nostr relay transmission queues.

Zéro cloud, chiffrement E2EE & mentions légales

ORBISnet ne dispose d\'aucun serveur central, base de données ou service d\'analyse. Les messages transitent par des relais Nostr ouverts qui ne peuvent pas lire le contenu chiffré. Aucune donnée d\'utilisation, adresse IP, identifiant ou contact n\'est jamais collecté ou revendu.

Toutes les communications (messages, notes vocales, publications, sondages) sont chiffrées sur votre appareil avec AES-256-GCM, Double Ratchet (PFS) et BIP-340 Schnorr adossés à l\'Android KeyStore matériel.

L\'historique de vos discussions, clés privées et publications est conservé localement dans le stockage protégé de l\'application. Vous pouvez exporter une archive chiffrée (PBKDF2) ou tout effacer à tout instant.

Les paquets chiffrés transitent par des relais Nostr ouverts et décentralisés. Bien que le contenu soit illisible sans vos clés, les relais peuvent observer les métadonnées de transmission (clés publiques, horodatage). L\'authentification SIM reste locale et privée.

ORBIS Guard: AI Scam & Phishing Detection
On-device neural filter against bank phishing, fake parcel delivery, and emergency scams.

ORBIS Guard-LLM is a 100% offline sovereign AI model running locally on your device. It scans incoming messages in real-time to detect banking fraud, fake delivery holds, and family emergency impersonations. Suspicious messages are automatically isolated in the \'Spam & Blocked\' tab with detailed threat level indicators. The AI continually learns from your actions without sending any data to remote servers.
Real-time contextual reply suggestions for encrypted chats and messages.

ORBIS Reply-LLM instantly analyzes the context of incoming messages and generates 3 relevant 1-tap quick replies. It natively supports French, English, Modern Standard Arabic, and Franco-Arabe / Darija. Over time, it learns your preferred phrases and ranks your favorite replies first with a star badge, completely privately on your device.
Proprietary Offline AI: Zero Cloud & Ultra-Light
Zero cloud servers, under 2 MB footprint, sub-10ms CPU inference.

Both ORBIS models (Guard and Reply) are built from the ground up using a proprietary vectorized Kotlin engine with INT8 quantized embeddings, requiring zero heavy external frameworks. With a combined size under 2 MB, inference completes in under 10 milliseconds directly on your phone\'s processor. No text or metadata is ever collected or transmitted.
